hints.title: Chunk the String
hints.text: Iterate through the string in strides of length k to extract each contiguous group.

hints.title: Inspect the Final Chunk
hints.text: If the final group has length less than k, pad the remaining characters using the fill character.

hints.title: Collect Groups
hints.text: Append all chunks into a list and return the resulting array.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(N) single pass or optimal algorithmic traversal
variables: N: input size or row count
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Manual single-character buffer manipulation without standard slicing introduces boundary errors.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear chunk extraction runs in O(N + k) time and O(N) space for output storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Clean boundary slicing and string padding implementation.
